meaning: The address of a web page.
clues: It names one web page, not a person or a device.
You can type it in the bar at the top of a browser.
It may include a site name and a path to one page.
Its name has three letters and starts with U.
assumes: An email address sends messages to a mailbox
A username identifies a person or account
An IP address is a number used to identify a device or network

decoys.meaning: A name that identifies a mailbox where you can send and receive email.
A name for a person on a computer service.
A number that names a device online.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. Open a browser and type a known web address yourself. Check each letter before you go.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Paper maps and address books helped us find places. A careful look still helps you get to the right page.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: If a message sends you a link, pause. You can type the known address instead.
